realAndSyntheticBoundary.runtime: Actual local production-mode web app, real authenticated UI/API, exact source/official overlay binding recorded separately.
realAndSyntheticBoundary.fixtures: Owned, isolated synthetic test workspaces, bots, messages and artifacts; browser notes/drafts are synthetic operator input. The BrowserPane used the actual local version page and actual element picker.
realAndSyntheticBoundary.faults: Controller-injected one-time Settings chunk delay and explicit Artifact RPC 503 faults; ordinary offline/online transitions trigger existing read behavior.
realAndSyntheticBoundary.noMessageCommentOrReplySubmissionsProven: root operator handoff and recorded manual action scope; not a claim of zero SQL/auth/scope/read-receipt writes

scenarios.observation: One real picker note and text draft survive an actual hosted Settings round trip with an 8000 ms delayed cold chunk (1 hit). A second real picker note continues numbering 1/2. The later explicit Settings Back/Forward/Back sequence retains both notes and draft. Returning Home after Artifact checks still shows them.
scenarios.scopeLimit: ComputerAgents registry persistence is covered by the real-provider component regression; this UI did not execute a computer/model session. Hosted Settings has its own intended visual frame, so no claim is made that the App frame stayed the same node through Settings.

scenarios.observation: Actual pointer Retry while a list 503 fault remained active preserves the two existing rows and local Retry. All three shell nodes and the list remain the same connected nodes. A second recorded click precedes fault removal. After removal, existing automatic reads recover; a later intended pointer click was intercepted until recovery and is not counted as a successful action.

Alt+T expands the actual Sonner stack in the Artifact modal. Tab navigation eventually reaches a confirmed BUTTON Retry. A real Enter while both faults persist increases observed metadata/text fault hits and retains Retry. After disabling both faults, focus is again confirmed on BUTTON Retry; Enter is followed by Retry hidden and no toast. The original document, scroll container, input, list and three shell nodes stay connected and identical.

operatorErrorsAndEvidenceLimits.source: root operator handoff plus recorded folded-stack geometry at #67
operatorErrorsAndEvidenceLimits.detail: The default folded stack may intercept a back toast pointer action. A post-clear Library click was not completed before automatic recovery and is not counted as success. No permanent deadlock is inferred.
The first Enter focused a toast LI rather than BUTTON Retry; its screenshot is excluded from publicGallery. The subsequent real button attempts are separately evidenced at #111–123.

The timing buffer predates the Artifact retries and cannot prove a new HTTP 200 or exact retry response count. Recovery evidence instead uses actual button activation, disappearance of the error/Retry and preserved UI state.

This run rechecks the two follow-up fixes and their scope/logout boundaries. It does not relabel the old 5a 296-operation/23-image suite, earlier API runs, native packaged CI, iOS, narrow-screen screenshots or the designated production smoke as new b73 browser coverage.
